# NIS2 Incident Notification (Art. 23)
**Incident ID:** {{INCIDENT_ID}} | **Severity:** {{SEVERITY}} | **Detected:** {{TIME}}

## Early warning (<=24h after detection)
To: national CSIRT + competent authority
- Incident detected, initial assessment underway
- Systems/entities affected (no sensitive detail yet)
- Point of contact: {{SOC_EMAIL}}

## Detailed notification (<=72h)
- Root cause (preliminary), TTPs observed (MITRE IDs)
- Impact: confidentiality/integrity/availability, data affected
- Containment actions taken + current status

## Final report (<=1 month)
- Full timeline, root cause, lessons learned, corrective actions
- Evidence bundle reference: docs/evidence/{{INCIDENT_ID}}/
